task: create a script that generates a random motivational quote with ASCII art border and shows current date and time

attempts.thought: The error is caused by Unicode box-drawing characters (╔, ║, ╚, ┌, │, └, ┏, ┃, ┗, ┓, ┛) that are not supported in the system's default encoding (cp1252). The fix is to replace these Unicode characters with standard ASCII characters that work in all encodings. I'll use characters like =, -, +, |, /, \, etc. to create similar-looking borders.
